name: Incoming call
oneLiner: a phone call screen rises and turns toward camera, lit from behind by the caller's own blurred photo; rings of light ripple off the avatar while it rings, then the green knob slides across, snaps, a green ring locks round the face and the label becomes a running call timer
say: when the speaker says 'then they called me' or 'my phone started ringing': it rings through the setup, the slide lands on 'I picked up'
